t: This is the site of Champion Lodge, which was a large house in Camberwell. It's described as a country house, a reminder that this part of south London was once a good deal more rural than it is now. The merchant and industrialist Thomas Starling Benson, who lived from 1775 to 1858, made his home here. So picture a substantial house with grounds, owned by a man of business, standing where the surrounding streets now are.
